utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll bring the gloves, flashlight, and a few trash bags. What should I tackle first when I get there?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Start by checking in at the community center desk, then head to the supply table and help sort the cleanup gear.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Will do — I’ll check in at the desk and then help sort the cleanup gear at the supply table.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can keep it around late Saturday morning and send over the simple list of tasks after school.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds perfect, Faye — thanks for keeping it handy and sending the list over. I’ll pass it along so everyone knows what to bring and do.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks, Jules — I’ll send it over after school and keep everything lined up for late Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Pia, any update on the repair drive? I’m out running errands, so I can pass along anything people need.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Ira — Rosa’s coordinating, and I’m still waiting on the timing and contact details. If you hear anything, please send it my way so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Pia — I’ll keep an eye out and pass along any timing or contact details I hear while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Will do, Noah — I’ll send the next homes over now.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — send them over, and I’ll take the next one. If you still need anything, I can help track down parts too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Noah — I’ll send the next homes over, and we can keep an eye out for nails and a ladder too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m still checking on which repair they’re starting with, but I can help confirm the order if you want.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Dane — that’d help. I’m still spreading the word, and once we confirm the first repair I’ll pass along the time, place, and task to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure — I’ll check on it and get back to you as soon as I know.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes — I’m checking our supplies now and will set aside what we can spare.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, thanks, Cleo — let me know what we’re short on and I’ll see if I can round up the rest.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Will do — I’ll sort through it and let you know what we’re short on as soon as I’ve checked.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’m still on it, and I’ll keep rounding up a few neighbors for the repair drive this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great — I’m ready to help with whatever you need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome, Sam — I’ll spread the word and let you know what I need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Eli — could you send me the repair drive location and the easiest route there?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sure — it’s at the community center on Sunday. Take Main Street straight down, then turn by the library; it’s the easiest route.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Eli — that’s exactly what I needed. I’ll head to the community center on Sunday via Main Street and the turn by the library.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re still able to help with the repair drive this week, right?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes — I’m still able to help with the repair drive this week. Just let me know what you need me to handle.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great — just to confirm, I’ll send you the time and place again, and you’re good for this week, right?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll swing by and help sort when I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — that helps a lot. Just a reminder, the repair drive is Sunday at the community center now, so I’ll keep the list updated and point people where they’re needed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — Sunday at the community center works for me. Just point me to wherever you need the quickest help.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Tess — I can bring the wrench and screwdriver for the repair drive. Just let me know when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Gus — that’s really helpful. I still haven’t heard the exact first repair, but I’ll let you know as soon as I do.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem, Tess — just keep me posted, and I’ll be ready with the wrench and screwdriver when you know the first repair.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sure — can you confirm the time and who’s coordinating? I’ll double-check the rest and keep the repair drive on track.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces, so I’m still piecing it together—do Rosa and Ira have the time pinned down? And do you know what they’re planning to fix first?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m not sure yet, but I can check with Rosa and Ira. If you hear the time or the first repair item, send it my way and I’ll keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks Mina — gloves and a flashlight are perfect. I’ll keep an eye out for any last-minute updates while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good — I’ll bring those and check in with you Saturday morning. If anything changes, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect — I’ll do that. I’m out running errands, so I’ll keep my phone on in case anything changes before Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Swing by the community center on Maple when you can. I’ll point you to the first fix.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Leo — I’ll swing by the community center on Maple. I’m glad you’ll point me to the first fix.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — see you there. I’ll have the first fix ready when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Hana — the repair drive is at the community center on Maple, just past the library. Take Oak over and turn right at the park.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — I’ll double-check the time and who’s coordinating, then keep the rest on track.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Hana — that works. Let me know if you need any more details for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can help with the repair drive. What would you like me to take care of first?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — could you confirm the timing and let me know if Rosa’s still coordinating? That’ll help me keep the logistics straight.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll confirm the timing and check whether Rosa’s still coordinating, then I’ll update you.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Send me the repair list, and I’ll sort it by priority.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Eli — that would help a lot. I’ll send the repair list over right now.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great — I’ll start sorting as soon as it comes in. Keep me posted if anything urgent needs attention first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re still able to help with the repair drive this week, right?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, I’m still able to help this week. Thursday early evening works best for me around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks for confirming — Thursday early evening works for me too. I’ll note you down for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. What should I handle first?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Could you start by helping with sorting and simple fixes, and if you can, bring gloves or any extra tools? If you’re able, I’d also love help rounding up a few more neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I can start with sorting and simple fixes, and I’ll bring gloves if I have them. I’ll also ask a couple neighbors to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Just the quick version—what are they fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check our supplies first and flag what we’re short on, so they can start with the biggest gaps.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—just tell me the biggest gaps, and I’ll handle the easiest fix.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, and I’m keeping the list organized. If you know any homes that need help, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Got it — I’ll keep spreading the word and send any homes that need help your way, Rosa.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — that really helps. I’ll keep the list updated and make sure everyone has the Sunday details.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I still haven’t heard which repair they’re starting with, but I’m asking around and will pass along anything solid right away.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Tess — I’ll keep asking around too and spread the word as soon as I hear which repair they’re starting with.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Quinn — appreciate it. I’ll do the same and let folks know as soon as I hear which repair they’re starting with.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits so far—what’s the first repair they’re tackling?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, I’m not sure yet — I just know I’m still in and need the details again. I can help once I’ve got the time and place straight.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it—once you have the time and place, send them my way and I’ll pass them along too.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
